power.note: guide example - fully loaded AC chassis, idle at 25 C

configs.description: Chassis only - what you spec before deciding what goes in it. The 2 slot bays are EMPTY; cooling, psus, res are populated. Enough to power on and reach the box, which is the question most people ask first and the one `default` used to answer with whatever the drawing happened to be populated with.
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: the DC PSM face (the guide's DC figures are isometric line art; the DC supply is also deeper - 274.3 vs 235.2 mm).
the printed PSM slot labels - the rear drawing's edge legends are not legible in any source, so left-stack-top-down 0-2 / right-stack 3-5 is an assumption.
the position of the two-hole protective earthing bracket on the side rail (M4 studs at 19.1 mm centres per the guide, location not drawn).
a photograph of the rear - only the schematic line drawing g009801 exists in the intake, so rear finish is inferred.

an `attrs.performance` section; `cpu`, `memory` in a missing `attrs.platform` section; one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power`; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in a missing `attrs.environmental` section (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 14 bays (front 4, rear 10) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

chassis.note: datasheet-table - 5.21 x 17.6 x 30 in (132.3 x 447 x 762 mm), 3RU; the guide physical table repeats it. Ears NOT MODELLED by convention (the rack face is 19 in / 482.6 mm)

color.note: photo - medium grey chassis and modules, light-blue ejector levers and SSD carrier (Juniper cloud-era styling)

front.note: photo - the frontwtop photograph measured at ~2.95 px/mm across the 447 mm body: RCBs at x 17.0 and 227.4 over rows y 2.0; MPCs at x 14.0 (centred 419.1 in 447), rows y 46.0 and 89.5; positions approximate to ~2 mm. The photograph and drawing g009800 agree on arrangement; the photograph wins on finish

fru-sizes.note: datasheet-table - the guide carries a full FRU dimension table (RCB 202.7 x 42.1, MPC 419.1 x 41.9, MIC 197.3 x 41.9, fan module 62.5 x 126.7, PSU 86.7 face); every component size is vendor-stated

other-faces.note: near-blank by evidence - rail bands estimated; axis conventions per viewer3d.js as the siblings

power.note: datasheet-table - the guide power example: fully loaded AC router 1676 W (4 fans 80 W + 2 MPCs 1320 W + 2 MICs 160 W + 2 RCBs 116 W)

rear.note: drawing - g009801: three-high PSM stacks at both rear corners and four vertical fan trays between them (FT 0-3). The drawing is schematic, so the stacks are anchored to the vendor PSU and fan module dimensions, not to drawing pixels. PSM slot numbering is not legible in any source - see gaps

sources.note: MX10003 Hardware Guide (223 pages, 66 figures), the MX10003 datasheet, the vendor front and rear line drawings (g009800/g009801) and the 'frontwtop' (front-with-top) studio photograph in the image library
